scope: Resolve the G27 L1-only train10 NaN blocker on the local Multiface real-GT adapter.

patch.summary: Skip SSIM, silhouette, and mono-depth branches when their effective weights are zero, preventing zero-weight nonfinite terms from contaminating total loss.
